# Requirements Traceability Matrix

<!-- generated by arch.generators.traceability_matrix; do not hand-edit -->

Req-ID → issues → PRs → commits → test evidence → approval (CH-5, #9733).
Requirement IDs are declared on issues as a `req:<id>` label or a
`Req-ID:` body line, carried into plan comments, PR bodies, and commit
trailers. Sources: `Req-ID:` lines in the last ≤500 PR-merge commits
reachable from HEAD, plus `Req-ID:` references in test docstrings under
`tests/`. Enforcement is a ratchet, not a gate: Req-IDs are mandatory only
for the regulated change class (`HydraFlowConfig.regulated_labels`, default
empty).
